clock_running: You’re already clocked in. Clock out first.
period_locked: That day is in a submitted timesheet, so its time can’t change. Ask a manager or admin to send the timesheet back.
project_archived: That project is archived. Choose another.
in_the_future: Worked time can’t be in the future.
clock_still_running: Clock out before submitting this timesheet.
not_awaiting_decision: It’s no longer waiting for a decision. Refresh to see where it stands.
own_approval: You can’t approve your own time. Your manager or an admin does.
in_use: It has time recorded against it, so it can’t be deleted. Archive it instead.
manager_loop: That would make someone their own manager.
